name: set_global_from_parameter_byte
description: Copies the second byte of the 32-bit parameter into the shared global variable and returns. It has no other effect.

name: increment_counter_and_save_global
description: Increments a byte counter, calls a routine, saves the current value of a shared global, sets that global to 127, calls the routine again and returns the saved value.

name: store_low_word_parameter_global
description: Stores the low 16 bits of the parameter into a fixed global variable, truncating the value to fit.

name: increment_counter_and_wait_limit
description: Increments a counter and calls a routine, then clamps a second counter to one below a limit and busy-waits while it stays under that limit, finally clearing it to zero.

name: call_routine_with_global_argument
description: Passes the value of one shared global variable as the argument to a called routine and returns.

name: call_routine_with_alternate_global
description: Passes a second shared global variable as the argument to a called routine and returns.

name: swap_globals_and_fill_table
description: Calls two routines, swaps two shared globals and sets a stride value to 40. It then fills four pairs of 16-bit table entries with a base value that rises by 40 per step, and calls routines three more times.

name: wait_and_configure_blitter
description: Waits until the blitter is idle, then sets its masks, modulo and control registers and loads its pointers from shared globals offset by constants. Writing the size register starts the blit.

name: wait_and_setup_blitter
description: Waits until the blitter is idle, then sets its masks, modulo and control registers and loads its two pointers from shared globals offset by constants, with the pointers assigned to swapped channel registers.

name: save_global_and_enable_interrupts
description: Copies the shared global into a saved counter and a fixed memory cell, then writes a value with bit 15 set to the interrupt enable register.

name: read_interrupt_and_position_registers
description: The decompiled code could not be produced, so only the register list is known. The routine accesses the interrupt enable, interrupt request and vertical beam position registers and calls one routine.

name: restore_saved_global_value
description: Copies the value saved in a counter back into the shared global variable.

name: call_routine_then_loop_forever
description: Calls a routine and then spins in an endless loop. The decompiler removed unreachable blocks, so the other calls in its call list are not visible in the pseudo-code.

name: stub_empty_routine
description: The pseudo-code is only a return, although the routine has 40 instructions, so its real body is not visible and it does no visible work.

name: copy_selected_source_words
description: Chooses one of two source pointers according to bit flags in a data register, then copies a fixed set of 32 words from it into a buffer, reading every other source word in reverse order.

name: return_input_register_byte
description: Returns the low byte of the data register it receives, without other processing.

name: return_input_register_byte
description: Returns the low byte of the data register it receives, without other processing.

name: call_routine_with_constant_one
description: Calls a routine with the constant argument 1 and returns, acting as a thin wrapper around that call.

name: call_routine_with_zero
description: Calls a routine with the constant argument 0 and returns, acting as a thin wrapper around that call.

name: write_scaled_word_to_table
description: Writes one 16-bit value into a global table at an index found by subtracting 3 from a shared counter. The value is the parameter's high word scaled by 256 plus a fixed constant.

name: call_routine_repeatedly_by_count
description: Calls one routine, then calls a second routine with a shared global value once for each count taken from the low word of the parameter, and finishes with a final call.

name: scan_table_for_marker_indices
description: Clears eight shared index variables, then scans a global table up to a terminating sentinel pair and records the positions of entries equal to 384 into those variables in turn.

name: advance_congruential_generator
description: Advances a 16-bit linear congruential sequence that starts at 101, for a number of steps taken from a shared counter. It returns the quotient of the result divided by 625 and a flag that says whether the remainder equals a shared target value.

name: set_cia_bits_after_delay
description: Waits through two short busy-wait loops, sets the upper five bits of a CIA port B register while keeping its low three bits, then waits once more.

name: prompt_quit_confirmation
description: Checks two global table entries and a set of input bits. When they match it shows the quit game prompt and reads keypresses until the reply is N or Y, calling a routine on Y.

name: delay_and_read_status_bit
description: Writes a control value to a CIA register, runs a long busy-wait, clears some bits of another CIA register, then returns 8 when bit 3 of a shared global is clear and 0 otherwise.

name: call_routine_chained_results
description: Calls a routine with two zero arguments and stores its result in a shared variable. It then passes that result to the same routine and stores the second result in another shared variable.

name: send_trackdisk_transfer_requests
description: Opens the trackdisk.device through the library, fills a request structure with a command code, a 1024-byte length and the supplied buffer address, and sends it. It then sends a second command with zero length and two more requests.

name: run_trackdisk_command_sequence
description: Opens the trackdisk.device through the library, then sends a sequence of request structures using command codes 3, 4 and 9 with a 1024-byte length on the first one and the supplied buffer address.

name: compute_and_check_block_checksum
description: Computes an 8-bit additive sum and an XOR over 249 bytes starting from fixed seeds. When the second parameter is zero it compares both values with the two bytes after the block and returns 0 on a match or 1 otherwise; otherwise it stores both values there and returns 65535.

name: compute_ones_complement_checksum
description: Zeroes the second word of a 256-word block, adds all words of the block with end-around carry, and stores the bitwise inverse of the sum in that second word.

name: call_reset_then_fixed_address
description: Calls a reset routine and then calls the constant low memory address 2 as code. The pseudo-code shows no other work.

name: open_keyboard_device_handles
description: Obtains a library handle, derives a second handle from it using the argument 48, and opens keyboard.device with the second handle and the shared request structure.

name: send_keyboard_request_with_buffer
description: Writes a command value of 10, a value of 13 and the address of the shared buffer into a request structure, sends it, and then calls one more routine.

name: scan_keyboard_state_changes
description: Compares a 14-byte keyboard state with the previous copy and, for each changed bit, computes a key index that is stored in a shared table. It refers to a string of key labels.

name: run_title_screen_loop
description: Loads the title and question-mark graphics by file name, then runs up to 220 polling iterations and returns early when a routine gives a non-zero result. It returns 1 when the loop ends on a non-zero answer and 0 when the loop runs out.

name: call_routine_with_range_bounds
description: Calls one routine four times: with the first parameter and 1, with the sum of both parameters minus 1 and 1, and twice with both parameters.

name: find_matching_record_index
description: Searches ten 20-byte records from last to first, comparing a field of each record with a value computed from a shared variable, and keeps the lowest index that passes. It calls other routines for the comparisons and returns a result.

name: run_selection_list_loop
description: Sets up a local array of list entries and a pointer into it, then loops while calling routines that poll input and update the selection. The output is cut off, so the exact input handling is not shown.

name: run_options_menu_loop
description: Shows the options labels and loops over menu input: option 1 toggles the player count between one and two, options 2 and 3 call a routine, and option 4 finishes and returns 1. A zero or negative result returns 0.

name: draw_controls_setup_screen
description: Draws the controls screen with its player 1 and player 2 entries, the load, save, reset and done options, and joystick text. It picks one of two alternative key-layout images from a stored flag and calls ten routines.

name: clear_and_mark_buffer_entries
description: Clears a 128-byte buffer, marks seven positions chosen by the bytes of the input string with the value 1, then feeds 77 entries of a global table to a routine, bracketed by two calls.

name: dispatch_table_case_calls
description: Looks up a byte in a global table using the second word of the parameter, then switches on the first word over cases 1 to 10 and calls routines at offsets from that byte.

name: load_production_scene_graphics
description: Loads a set of compressed graphics files for the production screen and shows the new production record and cheat-mode messages, using 29 routine calls.

name: show_credits_screen
description: Displays the credits text, including contributor names, a copyright line and a studio name, and uses 19 routine calls to lay out and time the screen.

name: draw_production_records_table
description: Draws a table header with the labels Name, Wages and Lvl and a Production Records title, then loops over rows and draws each row's fields.

name: copy_word_then_call_routine
description: Copies one 16-bit word within memory, calls a routine, then calls a second routine with the low 16-bit words of its two parameters.

name: call_routine_with_word_pair
description: Calls a routine with no arguments, then calls a second routine with the low 16-bit words of its two parameters.

name: call_routine_and_return
description: Calls one routine with no arguments and returns. It acts as a thin wrapper.

name: call_routines_in_sequence
description: Calls two routines with no arguments and two routines with a zero argument, in that order.

name: call_routine_and_return
description: Calls one routine with no arguments and returns. It acts as a thin wrapper.

name: load_logo_and_portrait_graphics
description: Loads compressed graphics for the logo, the character portraits and the status panel, and shows the presents text, using 15 routine calls.

name: display_title_graphic_and_text
description: Displays the title screen graphic and its SKID ROW text line, with display setup calls and a short delay, using 10 routine calls in total.

name: show_credit_names_until_input
description: Shows a list of credit names covering graphics, music and sound effects, then waits for key input. Certain key codes set a result value or toggle a flag, and the routine returns 1 or 0.

name: check_any_entry_flag_set
description: Loops over a count of 10-byte entries in a global table and calls a routine on each one, returning true as soon as a result has bit 4 set. If none does, it checks the base entry and returns whether that has bit 4 set.

name: draw_key_choice_prompt
description: Refreshes the display from shared state variables and calls one routine when bit 4 of the second parameter is clear. When bit 1 is set it draws the key choices N, O and Y.

name: show_character_name_portraits
description: Shows character names including Cliff Lemming, Frank Foreman, Jodee Lemming and Larry Lawyer, together with portrait graphics, using 11 routine calls and returning a short result.

name: show_get_ready_screen
description: Loads and displays office, character and orders graphics, and shows get ready messages for player 1 or player 2, using 22 routine calls.

name: convert_integer_to_base5_digits
description: Converts a 16-bit value into base-5 digits by repeated division by five, stores the digits in a local array, and uses them with seven routine calls.

name: show_financial_summary_screen
description: Renders the financial summary with wages, bonus and deduction labels and dollar amounts, and with cheat-mode messages, using 31 routine calls.

name: draw_wage_bonus_deduction_totals
description: Draws wage, bonus and deduction amounts with dollar labels and a PACKING heading, formatting each value as a seven-digit number, using 17 routine calls.

name: show_game_over_screen
description: Draws the GAME OVER screen with background and character graphics and the player 1 and player 2 labels, using 15 routine calls.

name: walk_table_with_start_value
description: Walks the entries of a global table in a loop, starting from a fixed value of 100 with an offset taken from the parameters, and calls nine routines to process them.

name: show_fixit_characters_form
description: Shows the Fiona Fixit and Fred Fixit form, loading form, fruit and palette graphics, using 19 routine calls and returning an unsigned result.

name: show_orders_with_return_prompt
description: Shows the orders graphic and a press F1 to return to game message, adjusts a shared value and uses 11 routine calls.

name: map_level_code_to_offset
description: Maps a shared code to one of several fixed offsets through a chain of comparisons, for example 1 to 0, 5 to 7, 11 to 14 and 17 to 21. It stores a copy of a shared value and calls seven routines, including GAME OVER text.

name: fill_local_text_buffer
description: Works on a local character buffer built from its two parameters and calls three routines. The visible pseudo-code is partly truncated, so the exact effect is not fully shown.

name: call_routine_with_low_word
description: Calls a routine with the low 16-bit word of its parameter and then calls a second routine with no arguments.

name: call_two_routines_in_order
description: Calls two routines with no arguments, one after the other.

name: format_two_digit_decimal
description: Writes a 16-bit value as two decimal digits, tens then units, followed by a zero terminator, into a three-byte text buffer.

name: repeat_while_flag_set
description: Repeatedly calls a routine on a global variable and calls a second routine while the returned value has bit 4 set. It stops when that bit is clear.

name: check_sprite_buffer_overflow
description: Compares the difference between the parameter and a shared base value against a fixed limit and, when the limit is exceeded, reports the sprite buffer overflow message.

name: setup_blitter_modulo_and_masks
description: Waits for the blitter to become idle, computes the modulo values from the parameters, then writes the blitter masks, modulo and control registers. It calls two routines.

name: wait_then_store_structure_fields
description: Waits until a status byte bit is clear, then stores four 32-bit values and one 16-bit value into a structure at fixed offsets.

name: configure_blitter_destination_offset
description: Waits for the blitter to become idle, computes a destination pointer from the parameters plus a shared offset, then sets the blitter masks, size and related registers.

name: configure_blitter_data_operation
description: Waits for the blitter to become idle, computes a pointer from the parameters and a shared offset, then sets the blitter masks, data and size registers.

name: pass_two_words_through
description: Passes its two 16-bit parameters to one routine and returns, acting as a thin wrapper.

name: clip_blit_coordinates
description: Subtracts a bound from a coordinate and, when the result is negative, shifts both coordinate values so the blit is clipped to the visible area. It then calls two routines.

name: wait_then_store_blit_fields
description: Waits until a status bit is clear, then stores two 32-bit values, a 16-bit value read through a pointer, and a 16-bit value into a structure at fixed offsets.

name: run_blitter_repeat_sequence
description: Waits for the blitter, sets its masks, size and two pointers from shared globals, then repeats the wait-and-start step eight times.

name: configure_blitter_modulo_from_index
description: Waits for the blitter to become idle, sets its masks and size, and writes a modulo value derived from a shared constant and the value the parameter points to.

name: compute_blit_dimensions
description: Computes a width in 16-bit words from the two position parameters, stores the width and a second value in an output array, and derives an offset for the blitter source and destination.

name: stub_undecoded_routine
description: The decompiler produced no pseudo-code for this routine, so its body is unknown. The recorded facts show 15 instructions and 21 callers, and nothing more can be said about its behaviour.

name: accumulate_string_character_widths
description: Walks a null-terminated string and, when a shared flag is clear, adds a width for each character using a shared metric. It returns a 32-bit result.

name: call_routine_with_word_pair
description: Calls a routine with no arguments, then calls a second routine with the low 16-bit words of its two parameters.

name: process_each_string_character
description: Calls a routine once for each character of a null-terminated string, passing it the first parameter and a shared value.

name: configure_blitter_three_channels
description: Waits for the blitter to become idle, then sets its masks, modulo values, control registers and size, and loads the channel pointers, using two routine calls.

name: shift_word_group_right_one
description: Shifts a group of four words right by one bit at an offset from a shared base, copying bits between neighbouring words and updating a byte view of each word.

name: initialize_game_variables
description: Sets several shared variables from routine results and constant offsets, clears two counters and sets another to one, then calls 21 routines to set up the game.

name: stub_empty_routine
description: The pseudo-code is only a return, and the routine is not reached in the reference run, so it does no visible work.

name: adjust_vertical_scroll_offset
description: Adjusts a shared vertical scroll offset from the parameter. It lowers the offset by 3 while the parameter is below 89, keeps it non-negative, and moves it to keep the parameter within a window of 16 units.

name: scan_table_records_for_position
description: Scans records of a global table in order, stopping when a record's value exceeds 999, and checks whether each record's range covers a running position.

name: call_routine_at_table_offset
description: Calls a routine at an address computed from a shared table base plus the high word of the parameter multiplied by eight, passing a second address as the argument.

name: add_decimal_digits_with_carry
description: Adds six decimal digits from a source string into a table of digits from the right, propagating carry and storing each result as an ASCII digit character. The recorded instruction count is far smaller than this code, so the entry may be only partly covered.

name: add_decimal_digits_with_carry
description: Adds six decimal digits from a source string into a table of digits from the right, propagating carry and storing each result as an ASCII digit character.

name: handle_pause_restart_prompt
description: Shows the game paused message and the restart game (y,n) prompt, reads the reply, and performs restart calls for one specific key code. It returns a short result from the key handling.

name: process_flagged_table_entries
description: Initialises a few shared counters, then loops over a table of flagged entries and processes each non-zero flag through fourteen routine calls, with the F.FIXIT text used.

name: run_demo_sequence
description: Loads the demo graphic, checks a shared flag, shows a numeric counter text, and calls 40 routines to run the demo sequence.

name: set_seven_flags_to_one
description: Sets seven shared byte values to 1 in a loop, then calls seven routines to set up the state.

name: write_fixed_values_to_table
description: Writes the constants 0, 16 and 6 into a shared variable in turn, writes the value 4095 into a table entry derived from a shared counter, and calls four routines.

name: read_table_entry_or_zero
description: Reads a table entry chosen by a shared index. It uses 0 when the entry equals the marker value 4095, otherwise the stored value, and calls one routine.

name: store_offset_table_entry
description: Adds the constant 273 to a value on the stack and stores the result in a table entry selected by a shared index, then calls one routine.

name: clear_state_on_status_change
description: When a shared value is 16 and a status bit newly appears, clears three shared variables and calls routines. The rest of the logic is cut off in the pseudo-code.

name: select_state_from_status_bits
description: Chooses a shared state value from two status bits, setting it to 0, to -2, or to another shared value, then calls two routines.

name: compute_masked_state_value
description: Sets a shared value to 0 or -2 depending on one status bit, reduces it to its low five bits, and calls a routine in a loop while the result is zero.

name: reset_masked_state_value
description: Clears a shared value, reduces it to its low five bits, and when the result is zero runs a loop that calls one routine.

name: decrement_counter_modulo_seven
description: Decrements a shared counter with wrap-around in the range 0 to 6, using three routine calls.

name: advance_index_until_match
description: Advances a local index with wrap-around through seven values until it reaches a shared counter.

name: increment_table_entry_and_reset
description: Increments one byte in a table indexed by a shared value and the parameter minus one, sets a shared byte to 6, and calls one routine.

name: copy_next_table_entry
description: If a shared counter plus one is not seven, copies a neighbouring table entry and calls one routine. The rest of the pseudo-code is cut off.

name: calculate_table_offset_for_index
description: Calculates a table offset from its two parameters using shifts and comparisons, and returns the result as a 32-bit value.

name: pass_two_words_through
description: Passes its two 16-bit parameters to one routine and returns, acting as a thin wrapper.

name: stub_undecoded_routine
description: The decompiler produced no pseudo-code for this routine, so its body is unknown. The recorded facts show 63 instructions and two callers, and nothing more can be said about its behaviour.

name: count_table_records_until_sentinel
description: Loops over 14-byte records of a global table until a sentinel value of -1 is reached, calling one routine for each record and accumulating a value when a shared flag is clear.

name: blit_table_entries_in_loop
description: Waits for the blitter, sets its masks, modulo and size registers, then loops over table entries from a shared count and starts a blit for each.

name: load_holder_and_still_graphics
description: Sets up a display region with routine calls, then loads the holder, IML and stills graphics files, using five routine calls and a branch on the parameter.

name: find_record_pointer_by_index
description: Returns a pointer into a global table of 24-byte records chosen by a shared index, walking forward through the records while their values stay at or below 999.

name: process_table_until_sentinel
description: Loops over 16-byte entries of a global table until a sentinel value of 65535, processing each entry with five routine calls.

name: update_nonzero_table_records
description: When a shared counter is zero, scans 16-byte table records up to a -1 sentinel and updates a field in each non-zero record, calling one routine.

name: read_record_byte_and_update
description: Reads a byte and a word from a 16-bit record passed by pointer, writes a value back when the word is non-zero, and calls one routine.

name: configure_blitter_from_parameters
description: Waits for the blitter to become idle, sets its modulo and control registers, and loads its size and pointers from values computed from the parameters.

name: initialize_display_buffers
description: Runs a routine on a 512-byte region of the global table, sets a shared pointer to its start, makes two routine calls, and resets several shared counters to zero.

name: load_backdrop_and_doll_graphics
description: Loads backdrop colour maps and the level, doll and related graphics files by name, using seven routine calls and a computed offset.

name: call_routine_five_times_indexed
description: Loops five times, calling a routine with a value derived from the loop index, and makes five further routine calls.

name: copy_word_block_from_structure
description: Copies 16-bit words in three groups of 16 from a buffer referenced by a structure into the caller's array.

name: copy_long_block_from_structure
description: Copies 32-bit values in three groups of 16 from a buffer referenced by a structure into the caller's array.

name: copy_eight_bytes_to_globals
description: Copies eight bytes from the caller's buffer into the shared global byte array, one at a time.

name: copy_rectangular_bit_block
description: Copies a rectangular block of values using row and column counts taken from a parameter array, moving through source and destination buffers at computed positions.

name: write_two_digit_decimal_text
description: Writes a two-digit decimal representation of a value plus one into a text buffer, then calls four routines to display it.

name: advance_timer_field_with_limit
description: Increments a timer field in a structure while a flag is clear. When the count exceeds 180 it calls routines to act on it, using five routine calls in total.

name: compute_status_code_from_flags
description: Builds a 32-byte local buffer from a shared flag, calls one routine, and returns a 32-bit status value derived from the result.

name: dispatch_state_by_flags
description: Reads a value from a table indexed by a shared mode, then selects an action from shared state flags, advancing a pointer in one case and calling two routines.

name: compute_offset_values_from_pointers
description: Calls a routine, then computes values from pointers to 16-bit words and a signed value passed in, using five routine calls, and returns an unsigned result.

name: update_countdown_state
description: Decrements a shared countdown and, when it reaches its end, updates several related shared values, using three routine calls.

name: update_counter_and_display
description: Updates a shared counter when its guard value is zero, using several local fields and five routine calls. It references the 0000100 numeric text.

name: update_secondary_counter_state
description: Updates a second shared counter in the same way, referencing the 0000100 numeric text and calling five routines.

name: update_signed_counter_toward_zero
description: Moves a shared signed counter toward zero one step at a time while a flag is set, and calls two routines when it reaches zero. It references the 0000075 numeric text.

name: compute_absolute_distance_check
description: Computes a position from table values and a character offset, then compares an absolute distance against a fixed threshold, calling one routine when the state matches.

name: initialize_position_variables
description: Sets a group of shared position and state variables to fixed starting values, including 230, 658 and 633.

name: build_graphics_list_nodes
description: Builds a linked list of entries that reference graphics files such as audrey, bigcliff, boni and candle, using two routine calls.

name: set_offsets_from_positions
description: Sets two shared offsets from shared position variables plus constants, then sets two more shared values to 0 and -4, and one to 240.

name: set_structure_bytes_to_four
description: Writes the value 4 into two byte fields, at offsets 11 and 15, of the structure referenced by a shared pointer.

name: set_structure_flag_bytes
description: Writes 0 and 1 into two byte fields, at offsets 11 and 15, of the structure referenced by a shared pointer.

name: call_routine_if_state_clear
description: Calls one routine only when a first shared value is zero, a second is non-zero and a third is zero. Otherwise it returns.

name: call_routine_if_flags_clear
description: Calls one routine when one shared value is non-zero and another is zero. Otherwise it returns.

name: call_routine_if_flag_zero
description: Calls one routine when a shared value is zero. Otherwise it returns.

name: call_routine_and_return
description: Calls one routine with no arguments and returns. It acts as a thin wrapper.

name: call_routine_if_state_clear
description: Calls one routine only when a first shared value is zero, a second is non-zero and a third is zero. Otherwise it returns.

name: call_routine_and_return
description: Calls one routine with no arguments and returns. It acts as a thin wrapper.

name: clear_structure_flag_byte
description: Writes 0 into the byte field at offset 11 of the structure referenced by a shared pointer.

name: clear_structure_flag_byte
description: Writes 0 into the byte field at offset 11 of the structure referenced by a shared pointer.

name: set_state_in_position_range
description: When a shared position lies strictly between 101 and 123, sets shared state values depending on a flag, sets another to 4, and calls one routine.

name: reset_shared_state_values
description: Sets five shared state variables to the constants 5, 4, 4, 16 and 0.

name: xor_shared_byte_and_call
description: Exclusive-ORs a shared byte with 3, then calls one routine with the address of that byte.

name: xor_shared_byte_and_call
description: Exclusive-ORs a shared byte with 3, then calls one routine with the address of that byte.

name: xor_byte_and_call_chain
description: Exclusive-ORs a shared byte with 3, calls one routine with its address, then calls two more routines.

name: xor_byte_and_call_pair
description: Exclusive-ORs a shared byte with 3, calls one routine with its address, then calls one more routine.

name: toggle_structure_flag_and_set
description: Flips the lowest bit of the byte field at offset 11 in the structure referenced by a shared pointer, and sets the byte at offset 15 to 1.

name: toggle_structure_flag_and_set
description: Flips the lowest bit of the byte field at offset 11 in the structure referenced by a shared pointer, and sets the byte at offset 15 to 1.

name: toggle_structure_flag_and_set
description: Flips the lowest bit of the byte field at offset 11 in the structure referenced by a shared pointer, and sets the byte at offset 15 to 1.

name: toggle_flag_by_position_side
description: Chooses one of two structures by whether a shared position is below 160, then toggles its flag byte at offset 11 and sets the byte at offset 15 to 1.

name: toggle_structure_flag_and_set
description: Flips the lowest bit of the byte field at offset 11 in the structure referenced by a shared pointer, and sets the byte at offset 15 to 1.

name: toggle_structure_flag_and_set
description: Flips the lowest bit of the byte field at offset 11 in the structure referenced by a shared pointer, and sets the byte at offset 15 to 1.

name: set_flag_by_position_side
description: Sets the byte at offset 11 to 1 in one of two structures, chosen by whether a shared position is below 160.

name: set_flag_byte_to_one
description: Writes 1 into the byte field at offset 11 of the structure referenced by a shared pointer.

name: cycle_structure_counter_byte
description: Increments a byte field at offset 11 of a structure, wrapping back to 0 after 4, so it cycles through the values 0 to 4.

name: cycle_shared_counter_to_four
description: Advances a shared counter that wraps to 0 after reaching 4, when a second shared value allows it, and uses a stored value from a structure.

name: set_flag_variable_to_one
description: Sets one shared flag variable to 1.

name: set_flag_variable_to_one
description: Sets one shared flag variable to 1.

name: set_flag_variable_to_one
description: Sets one shared flag variable to 1.

name: arm_countdown_if_flags_clear
description: Sets a shared countdown to 12 when several shared flags are in their expected states and the countdown is currently zero.

name: set_countdown_when_flag_nonzero
description: Sets a shared countdown to 12 when a shared flag is clear, another value is non-zero and the countdown is currently zero.

name: set_countdown_if_active
description: Sets a shared countdown to 12 when another shared value is non-zero and the countdown is currently zero.

name: set_countdown_if_zero
description: Sets a shared countdown to 12 when it is currently zero.

name: dispatch_by_position_band_guarded
description: When shared flags are clear and a value is non-zero, calls one of three routines depending on whether a shared position is below 104, below 176, or higher.

name: dispatch_by_position_band_unguarded
description: Calls one of three routines depending on whether a shared position is below 104, below 176, or higher, once a shared flag check passes.

name: dispatch_by_position_band_enabled
description: When a shared value is non-zero, calls one of three routines depending on whether a shared position is below 104, below 176, or higher.

name: dispatch_by_position_band
description: Calls one of three routines depending on whether a shared position is below 104, below 176, or higher.

name: dispatch_by_position_pair
description: Calls one of two routines depending on whether a shared position is below 176.

name: call_routine_and_return
description: Calls one routine with no arguments and returns. It acts as a thin wrapper.

name: arm_timer_and_flags
description: When a shared value is non-zero and a timer is zero, sets that timer to 21 and sets two byte flags in a structure.

name: set_second_timer_if_zero
description: Sets a shared timer to 12 when it is currently zero.

name: advance_counter_modulo_five
description: Advances a shared counter by one and wraps it modulo 5, so it cycles through the values 0 to 4.

name: arm_band_timer_by_position
description: Sets one of two shared timers to 5 when a matching shared flag equals -1 and that timer is zero, choosing the timer by whether a shared position is below 160.

name: arm_timer_if_flag_minus
description: Sets a shared timer to 5 when another shared value equals -1 and the timer is currently zero.

name: set_band_timer_by_position
description: Sets one of two shared timers to 12 when it is currently zero, choosing the timer by whether a shared position is below 160.

name: set_band_timer_if_zero
description: Sets a second shared band timer to 12 when it is currently zero.

name: compute_status_byte_from_table
description: Calculates a status byte from a position parameter by indexing a table of 16-bit words with the parameter's coordinates, and returns it as a byte.

name: scan_table_rectangle
description: Walks a rectangular area of a global table whose bounds come from the parameter's coordinates shifted right by three, and returns a 16-bit result.

name: scan_table_rectangle_single
description: Walks a rectangular area of a global table with bounds from the parameter's coordinates shifted right by three, calls one routine, and returns a 16-bit result.

name: scan_table_rectangle_offset
description: Walks a rectangular area of a global table starting one past the parameter's shifted coordinates, calls two routines, and returns a 16-bit result.

name: calculate_grid_index_from_offsets
description: Calculates an index from the differences between shared offsets and the parameter, scaled by eight, and returns it as a 32-bit value after one routine call.

name: scan_table_rectangle_double
description: Walks a rectangular area of a global table starting one past the shifted coordinates and returns a 16-bit result through two routine calls.

name: clear_seven_table_entries
description: Resets a shared counter to 0 and clears seven 32-bit fields spaced through the global table.

name: register_handler_in_next_slot
description: Stores a handler code pointer into the next slot of a global table while the slot offset is below the table limit of 224, then returns. The NuSh text is referenced.

name: set_flags_for_parameter_match
description: When a shared counter exceeds 7 and the parameter equals 214, sets shared flags depending on whether a shared value lies within a range of 19 units.

name: clear_entry_table
description: Clears 40 entries of a global table, each 28 bytes apart, by zeroing their leading fields, then clears a second set of entries the same way.

name: call_handler_chain
description: Decrements a counter, then walks a linked chain of entries, calling each non-null handler stored in an entry and moving on to the next.
